newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil up on stronger futures and premiums.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil up on stronger futures and premiums.

text.p: NWE gas oil was slightly firmer on Friday in line with stronger benchmark IPE gas oil futures and higher premiums, traders said.
July IPE gas oil closed $2 higher at $163.75 a tonne.
Heating oil barges traded at around July IPE +25 cents fob ARA, and premiums were talked around the July IPE flat/+50 cents fob ARA for first-half July delivery.
Diesel premiums were little changed and were talked around the July IPE +$5/+$6 fob ARA.
Cargo premiums were slightly firmer with 38,000 tonnes of prompt Russian trading at July IPE +$1.25 cif NWE for fairly prompt delivery.
Other 0.2 percent material was offered at between +$3 to +$4 for promptish delivery.

A Nordic trader said he had been on the verge of selling 10,000 tonnes of heating oil into Hamburg at around July IPE +$4 for July 1-5 delivery but the deal had fallen through after he was unable to fix a suitable vessel.
Low sulphur premiums were steady in the July IPE +$6/+$7 cif NWE range with a cargo heard trading at around July IPE +$6.75 cif NWE earlier on.
